Title: Azure Monitor status blog is now available

Body.Content:
The Azure Monitor Status blog provides timely updates on the health of Azure Monitor products (Application Insights, Log Analytics, Service Map, Azure Alerts).

This status blog is managed by our SRE (Site Reliability Engineering) team. It provides detailed information on ongoing outages, planned maintenance events, or advisory notifications. The intention of this blog is to provide transparent communication to all our customers.
